assumptions.assumption: Provisional rough boundary used as site boundary
assumptions.justification: Official precise boundary not yet available in repository
assumptions.impact: All area calculations are provisional; recalculable when official boundary arrives

assumptions.assumption: FAR, building height, green ratio, building density are concept reference values, not statutory controls
assumptions.justification: Official regulatory planning controls are missing (status=missing in planning_limits.json)
assumptions.impact: All quantitative planning indicators are advisory only

assumptions.assumption: Building footprints are concept-generated within key areas based on grid layout
assumptions.justification: No official building survey or parcel data available
assumptions.impact: Building count, GFA, and density are concept estimates only

assumptions.assumption: Land use partition follows north-south functional gradient (research-living-industry)
assumptions.justification: Based on brief positioning and key area designations
assumptions.impact: Land use allocation is a design proposal, not statutory zoning

assumptions.assumption: Road network follows railway corridor alignment with east-west connections
assumptions.justification: Based on brief boundary text and key area locations
assumptions.impact: Road centerlines are concept suggestions, not road redlines

assumptions.assumption: Green space includes railway heritage park corridor and perimeter buffer
assumptions.justification: Based on brief positioning of 京张遗址公园 as cultural mainline
assumptions.impact: Green ratio is conceptually high (43.6%); actual ratio depends on official zoning

assumptions.assumption: South-to-north phased implementation starting from Dazhongsi
assumptions.justification: Dazhongsi is smallest and most commercially ready area
assumptions.impact: Phasing is a concept suggestion, not development schedule approval

assumptions.assumption: AI ecosystem cases drawn from public knowledge of global AI clusters
assumptions.impact: Case insights are reference, not investment commitments

assumptions.assumption: Jing-Zhang railway heritage is core cultural narrative thread
assumptions.justification: Brief explicitly designates 京张铁路遗址公园 as cultural mainline

assumptions.assumption: Average floor height assumed at 3.5m for GFA estimation
